description: Mia insights: things in the books worth a look, found by fixed rules from records already in the books: spending in a category or with a supplier well above its usual level, a monthly charge whose price went up or that was charged twice, likely duplicate bills or expenses, expenses with no receipt above the owner's threshold, customers paying later than they used to, and bank lines left unsorted. Each insight has a plain-English headline, the figures behind it and the records it is about (kindCode DOCUMENT, ENTRY or BANK_LINE with their ids). Most pressing first; dismissed and snoozed ones are left out. These are suggestions to look at, not advice: say so when you pass them on, and never say a record is wrong, only that it may be worth checking.
